name: azubatrends
description: AzubaTrends storefront — Cloudflare Pages Functions + Firestore REST
comment_dependencies: firebase-admin, pdfkit, and archiver from the old Vercel version are gone for good — lib/firestore-rest.js fully replaces firebase-admin, and pdf-lib + fflate (below) replace pdfkit + archiver for invoice/invoice-bulk (see lib/invoice.js). Run `npm install` before deploying so these are actually present in node_modules for the Pages build.
